quests.title: Alfred's Bouquet

dialogue.sit: I believe you needed some Windwheel Asters...

dialogue.t: Ah, you must have seen my commission, then. Thanks for coming all this way.
So, do you have three Windwheel Asters ready?
I'm sure my daughter will love them.
Thank you very much. Here's a little something for your trouble.

quests.description: Alfred from Mondstadt needs three Windwheel Asters.
